meta.requirement: Explore Springvale (1%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: tip
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Skills and Prayers
start.text:
''Near one of the farmhouses at the edge of Springvale, you notice a woman in white robes crouching before a Swordsman. Her hands are folded over his, her lips moving in quiet prayer. The Swordsman's eyes are closed. A faint warmth seems to radiate from the two of them, though it may just be the afternoon sun.''

''You slow your pace. Something about the moment feels deliberate. Significant''.

apprch.text:
''The Nun finishes her prayer and rises gracefully. She notices you with a calm smile''.

Nun: You are welcome to observe. The blessing is almost complete. ''She turns back and places one hand over the Swordsman's sword hilt, murmuring a final verse''.

''The Swordsman opens his eyes. He looks different somehow. More settled. He bows his head to the Nun, then rises and walks away without a word''.

choices.label: What did you do to him?

whtudo.text: Nun: ''tilts her head thoughtfully'' Nothing that was not already inside him. A skill blessing anchors what the body has learned and gives it form. That man has fought for years. He simply did not know how to call on what he already knew. ''she folds her hands'' Now he does.

choices.label: Skills can be blessed into someone?

magik.text: Nun: *smiles* It is faith, traveller. Faith in the body, in the wind, in something larger than a single sword arm. The Church does not conjure skills from nothing. It teaches the spirit to listen. *pauses* That is a subtle distinction, I know. Magic is faster to say.

choices.label: Can anyone receive a skill blessing?

Skills_can_be_blessed_into_someone.text: Nun: Anyone who is willing, yes. The Cathedral in Mondstadt City offers skill instruction to all who come. The Church asks only that those who wish to learn first make a small offering. Twenty silver pieces, donated to the church fund. It covers the candles, the texts, the time. ''A gentle smile''. The Archon does not charge for blessings. The building, however, does have a roof to maintain.

choices.label: Twenty silver for access to skills?

20silv.text: Nun: That is all. Once the donation is recorded, the Cathedral's doors are open to you whenever you are in Mondstadt. The instructors there can teach you things that no dungeon or battlefield can. ''She studies you with kind eyes''. You look like someone who would benefit from it. Will you go?

choices.label: I will. Twenty silver to the church

willthnk.text:
Nun: There is no rush, traveller. The Cathedral has stood for three hundred years. It will be there when you are ready. ''She begins gathering her things''. Take your time. I will be in the fields awhile longer if you wish to speak again.

''She walks a short way down the path, white robes trailing through the grass''.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Return to the Nun in Springvale in 3 hours. The donation may change

continues.label: Wait 3 hours in real life, then travel to Springvale and talk to the nun

silv20ch.text:
Nun: ''nods warmly'' Good. The Cathedral will be expecting you. Just twenty silver at the entrance, and all of its teachings are yours. ''She glances back toward the fields''. Another blessing waits. Safe travels, traveller.

''She walks away into the tall grass, her white robes catching the wind''.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Donate 20 Silver to the Church of Favonius in Mondstadt

rtrnnun3hr.text:
''You find the Nun again near the same farmhouse. She looks up from a small prayer book tucked under one arm''.

Nun: Back already? ''She tilts her head''. While you were deciding, word reached me from Mondstadt. The church council reviewed its costs. Roof tiles, hymnals, winter fuel for the dormitory. The required offering is seventy silver now, not twenty.

Nun: ''A sympathetic smile''. I am sorry. The Cathedral and its instructors are unchanged. Only the donation has gone up. Will you still go?

choices.label: I need more time to think

70slvgo.text:
Nun: ''nods warmly'' Good. The Cathedral will be expecting you. Seventy silver at the entrance, and all of its teachings are yours. She'' glances back toward the fields''. Another blessing waits. Safe travels, traveller.

''She walks away into the tall grass, her white robes catching the wind''.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Donate 70 Silver to the Church of Favonius in Mondstadt

mrtimrtothn.text: Nun: ''nods without judgment'' Then take it. The Cathedral is not going anywhere, and neither am I for a little while yet. ''She glances toward the fields''. Come find me when you are ready.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Donate 70 Silver to the Church of Favonius in Mondstadt

Donate_70_Silver_to_the_Church_of_Favoni.text:
''The Cathedral of Favonius rises at the heart of Mondstadt City, pale stone and tall windows catching the afternoon light. At the entrance, Barbara stands beside a donations box with a handwritten notice pinned beside it''.

Barbara: Welcome, traveller. Are you here to make the offering? Seventy silver, as the council set it.

choices.label: Seventy silver. Fine, for the skill blessing.
I am just looking for now
I'll return when I have enough silver

donet70.title: Donation Made, 70 Silver
donet70.text:
''You count out seventy silver pieces into the donations box. Barbara records each one in her ledger without comment, though her smile when she looks up is genuinely relieved''.

Barbara: Recorded. ''She closes the ledger''. The Cathedral's instructors are available whenever you are in Mondstadt. You can visit any time and learn at your own pace. ''She gestures toward the inner doors''. Welcome, traveller. This place is yours.

looknarnd70.text: Barbara: ''smiles patiently'' Of course. Take your time. The Cathedral is always open, and the donation box is right here when you are ready. Seventy silver is all we ask now.

rtrnltr70.text:
Barbara: ''nods warmly'' Of course. The donation box will be right here when you return. Seventy silver is all we ask.

''You step away from the entrance for now. The Cathedral will wait''.

donet20.title: Donation Made, 20 Silver
donet20.text:
''You place twenty silver pieces into the donations box. Barbara counts them with a practiced eye and writes your name in a small ledger''.

Barbara: Recorded. ''She looks up with a genuine smile''. The Cathedral's instructors are available whenever you are in Mondstadt. You can visit any time and learn at your own pace. ''She gestures toward the inner doors''. Welcome, traveller. This place is yours.

''You step away from the entrance for now. The Cathedral will wait''.
